name: cheaplive
description: > 一个面向移动端个人主播的零成本虚拟主播直播辅助工具。 > 无需电脑，纯浏览器端运行，让任何有手机的普通人都能成为虚拟主播。

scripts.test:e2e: node tests/run-e2e.mjs tests/e2e/runtime-gate.test.js tests/e2e/motion-capture-beta.spec.mjs tests/e2e/playwright-smoke.test.cjs tests/e2e/face-capture-smoke.test.cjs tests/e2e/receiver-face-frame.test.cjs tests/e2e/voice-changer-ui.test.cjs tests/e2e/subtitle-broadcast.spec.mjs --project=chromium-desktop
scripts.test:webrtc: npx playwright test tests/e2e/webrtc-connected.test.cjs tests/e2e/audio-track.test.cjs tests/e2e/multi-device.test.cjs --project=chromium-desktop
scripts.test:gate: node --test tests/unit/*.test.js && npx playwright test tests/e2e/playwright-smoke.test.cjs tests/public-status --project=chromium-desktop --reporter=list
scripts.test:all: npm run test:unit && npm run test:assets && npm run test:signaling && npm run test:e2e
